title: neobartsia inaequalis subsp. duripilis
intro: Neobartsia inaequalis subsp. duripilis, commonly known as Bolivian rose, is a plant species native to South America. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant is reported to have therapeutic actions such as anti-anxiety and antispasmodic effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Neobartsia inaequalis subsp. duripilis for medicinal use.
